rules.title: Test the ARTIFACT you ship, not the source you wrote
Assert the OBSERVABLE END STATE, not intermediate artifacts
Probe for SILENT failures
Read the ACTUAL error before changing anything
Clean-room verification (defeat caches and local state)
Every fixed bug gets a REGRESSION test
Test triggers AND non-triggers
Test state machines for deadlock and bad transitions
Browser-test every interface you TOUCH, during the build
Definition of done (all must hold)
Report honestly
Test the OPERATOR-FACING OUTCOME, not the machinery
Nothing is delivered until CONSUMED BY A SURFACE
Every feature spec ships an E2E behavioral test through the REAL entry point
Bound every long-running operation: state the expected duration, then enforce it
Determinism: a flaky test is a defect
Delivery report (P14): the fields that make it verifiable
Escaped-defect feedback loop (P21)
Test selection for the inner loop (P25; the DoD gate never moves)
The model is asserted, not assumed (P27)
A numeric performance claim carries its measurement contract (P31)
Performance work is placed, not scheduled (P34)
Every gate ships with a negative control, an autonomous exit, and a budget (P27)
